Generates configuration material to enable two-factor authentication. There are no request arguments. The optional secret and otpauth_str fields are strings containing sensitive authentication material; otpauth_str is the one-time authentication URL for QR encoding. The client does not fetch the URL, render the QR code or compute a TOTP.

Uses form POST because the pinned operation declares x-readonly=false. The source declares no rollback; no automatic retry or rollback occurs. Retain optional fields and reject null or absent data. Treat returned configuration and PayloadMismatchException::$payload as sensitive; do not log them. Payload content is not copied into responseMeta().
